import json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
cases=[
"tests/test_foundation_ledger_leases.py::test_lease_owner_checks_and_expired_takeover",
"tests/test_foundation_ledger_leases.py::test_run_state_uses_compare_and_swap_and_append_only_events",
"tests/test_foundation_ledger_leases.py::test_submission_intent_is_idempotent_and_blocks_duplicate_submit"]
candidates=[Path(sys.executable),root/".venv/bin/python"]
runs=[]
for python in candidates:
 if not python.is_file():continue
 try:
  proc=subprocess.run([str(python),"-B","-m","pytest","-q","-p","no:cacheprovider",*cases],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90,env={**os.environ,"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1"})
  runs.append({"python":str(python),"returncode":proc.returncode,"stdout":proc.stdout[-5000:],"stderr":proc.stderr[-1500:]})
  if proc.returncode==0:break
 except (OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:runs.append({"python":str(python),"error":str(error)})
print(json.dumps({"state":"foundation_regression","runs":runs,"test_cases":cases,"repository_writes_requested":False,"browser_dispatch_touched":False,"real_applications_submitted":0},sort_keys=True))
if not runs or runs[-1].get("returncode")!=0:raise SystemExit(2)
